rationale: The portfolio already holds a substantial short position in AXON representing 14.9% of total buying power, which aligns with the ongoing intraday downtrend below both VWAP ($309.06) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($303.50). Adding to the short near the psychological $300.00 support level after a $21+ intraday drop offers poor risk-reward, while going long would conflict with existing exposure and persistent relative weakness against a strong broader market. Therefore, skipping to let the existing position work is the optimal risk-management decision.
